content_sections.heading: ZSS Khordha Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ZSS Khordha Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ZSS Khordha Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ZSS Khordha Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Medical Officer (SNCU): MBBS preferably having experience of working in Paediatric ward for 02 yrs. Though MD (Pediatrics)/ DCH are preferable, Must have valid Registration from Odisha Council of Medical Registration. MO (MBBS) (DEIC): MBBS or equivalent degree from an Institutions recognized and approved by Medical Council of India. Must have completed compulsory Internship and also must have valid Registration from the State Council of Medical Registration.

content_sections.heading: ZSS Khordha Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 21 years Maximum Age: 67 years Age relaxation rules are not specified in the provided data.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ZSS Khordha?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the ZSS Khordha Medical Officer posts is scheduled for 30 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: The basic educational qualification required is MBBS. Specific experience and additional qualifications like MD (Pediatrics) or DCH may be preferable for certain posts as detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Medical Officer posts is between a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 67 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for the ZSS Khordha recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 77165, along with other applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Medical Officer post in Zilla Swasthya Samiti Khordha.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the ZSS Khordha Medical Officer posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview, followed by the preparation of a Merit List based on the performance of the candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.
